name: io.github.sangaraju1988/amu-pgvector
title: amu-pgvector
description: Lineage-gated agent memory tools on Postgres + pgvector, enforced by row-level security.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: Installs with the [mcp] extra, required for the amu-pgvector-mcp console script's mcp SDK dependency (it's optional at the base-package level so the Python client and LangChain integration don't pull it in unnecessarily).

environmentVariables.name: AMU_PGVECTOR_DSN
environmentVariables.description: Postgres DSN for the role this server runs as. Results are gated by row-level security under this exact role -- use an amu_writer-member role for amu_record/amu_check_conflict, or an amu_agent_base-member role for read-only amu_search.

environmentVariables.name: AMU_PGVECTOR_EMBEDDING_DIM
environmentVariables.description: Embedding vector dimension, used only by the built-in deterministic fallback embedder when sentence-transformers (the amu-pgvector[st] extra) isn't installed. Must match the dimension sql/amu_pgvector.sql was installed with. Default: 1536.
